claim_scope: Wokwi virtual-hardware acceptance tests, not physical-hardware validation

completed_public_run.note: The workflow was removed after this single successful run to conserve Wokwi CI quota.

scenarios.interpretation: The virtual inertial sequence reached the local alarm and alert-due path. Network delivery was not tested.
A 5 g pulse without qualifying rotation was rejected.

observations: GPIO26 low after a 16000 ms post-cancellation guard
scenarios.retry_reason: Wokwi transport closed with code 1006 before simulation startup
scenarios.interpretation: The virtual cancel button suppressed the pending alert beyond its original 15 s deadline.

limitations: No physical sensor, actuator, power, enclosure, or mounting behavior was measured.
No Wi-Fi, HTTPS, Blynk, or phone-hotspot delivery was attempted.
Wokwi sensor controls provide prescribed virtual values rather than a mechanical crash model.
